name: MG TC Supercharged 1949
description: The MG TC was a British sports car produced from 1945-1949. This supercharged version features a 1250cc XPAG inline-4 engine producing 70 bhp at 4500 rpm. With its lightweight construction, separate fenders, and narrow body, the TC was the first MG widely exported to America, helping ignite the post-war sports car boom. Classic pre-war styling combined with nimble handling made it a favorite among enthusiasts.
